description_en: Adds DNS forwarding configurations to an SCG5000 or SCG5000-5G instance. The device version must be 3.4.2 or later
description_zh: 添加DNS转发，适用于设备类型为SCG5000或SCG5000-5G的智能接入网关实例，且设备版本为3.4.2及以上
kebab_example: aliyun smartag add-smart-access-gateway-dns-forward --sag-ins-id sag-v9un1ccz22owd76lf8 --sag-sn sagf4dkqh78 --domain www.aliyun.com --master-ip 114.114.114.114 --slave-ip 172.16.0.14 --biz-mode first --outbound-port-type Tunnel --outbound-port-index 0 --outbound-port-name eth0 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddSmartAccessGatewayDnsForward

parameters.help_en: The serial number (SN) of the device
parameters.name: sag_sn

parameters.help_en:
The domain name.

> 
*   Wildcard domain names are supported. You can use the wildcard character asterisk (\*) to specify a wildcard domain name.

For example, you can enter \*.baidu.com to specify the domain name baidu.com
parameters.help_zh:
域名
> 
>- 支持泛域名，支持全量匹配（域名填写“*”）。例如:
*.baidu.com 允许输入的格式为 baidu.com
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en:
The forwarding mode.

> 
*   This parameter is not in use. Ignore this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
转发模式

>- 无效字段，不用关注
parameters.name: mode

parameters.help_en:
The type of the egress port.

> 
*   A value of Tunnel specifies a tunnel, and a value of PhysicalPort specifies a physical port
parameters.help_zh:
出接口类型
>- Tunnel代表隧道口，PhysicalPort代表物理口
parameters.name: outbound_port_type

parameters.help_en:
The number of the egress port.

> 
*   This parameter is optional if OutboundPortType is set to PhysicalPort. Ignore this parameter if OutboundPortType is set to Tunnel.
*   The value of OutboundPortIndex is the unique index of the port name specified by poOutboundPortName. For example, 0 is the index for the port named eth0, and 2 is the index for the port named lte
parameters.help_zh:
出接口序号
>- OutboundPortType为PhysicalPort时选填，OutboundPortType为Tunnel时不用填写；
>- OutboundPortIndex和OutboundPortName一一对应：0 - eth0；2 - lte
parameters.name: outbound_port_index

parameters.help_en:
The egress port.

> 
*   This parameter is optional if OutboundPortType is set to PhysicalPort. Ignore this parameter if OutboundPortType is set to Tunnel.
*   The value of OutboundPortIndex is the unique index of the port name specified by poOutboundPortName. For example, 0 is the index for the port named eth0, and 2 is the index for the port named lte
parameters.help_zh:
出接口
>- OutboundPortType为PhysicalPort时选填，OutboundPortType为Tunnel时不用填写；
>- OutboundPortIndex和OutboundPortName一一对应：0 - eth0；2 - lte
parameters.name: outbound_port_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the instance is deployed
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关实例所属的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id
